open_obligations.description: Do not lift the monotone lower bound to general circuits without a transfer lemma.

scenarios.claim: A monotone-circuit lower-bound lemma is a sourced local entrypoint, not yet a general circuit lower bound.
scenarios.scope: P-vs-NP; monotone-to-general regime boundary remains explicit
scenarios.evidence: Provenance-bearing LaTeX source, normalized theorem body, target grounding, and hub-bias audit.
scenarios.falsifier: Natural-proofs or relativization pressure invalidates any route that silently generalizes the lemma.

open_obligations.description: Continuum coercivity remains an obligation rather than an inferred result.

scenarios.claim: Two reflected Wilson-block carriers should be compared before choosing a formal claim.
scenarios.scope: Yang-Mills representation design under a frozen literature context
scenarios.evidence: Independently matured carrier hypotheses and blind plural adjudication.
scenarios.falsifier: Failure of carrier equivalence or loss of gauge-invariant observables returns the claim to conceptual repair.

scenarios.claim: The barrier-specificity theorem is exact, quantified, source-bound, and limited to its declared circuit model.
scenarios.scope: P-vs-NP barrier analysis; no claim of P unequal NP
scenarios.evidence: Formal obligations, an acyclic lemma chain, and target-specific inference review.
scenarios.falsifier: An ambiguous quantifier, circular lemma, or model mismatch rejects the proof candidate.

open_obligations.description: Novelty remains bounded by the recorded comparison set.

scenarios.claim: A finite-volume Wilson-block estimate is reusable and paper-worthy without being a continuum mass-gap result.
scenarios.evidence: Result-atlas change, value assessment, main-problem alignment, and enablement audit.
scenarios.falsifier: If the estimate enables no subsequent obligation, it remains a support result rather than a main contribution.

scenarios.claim: An explicit finite-endpoint result fills one marked manuscript module while continuum claims remain excluded.
scenarios.scope: Finite object and theorem packet; asymptotic and continuum scopes separated
scenarios.evidence: Scope certificate, finite-object definition, proof packet, prior-art audit, and expansion validation.
scenarios.falsifier: An unresolved marker, prior-art disqualifier, or finite-to-continuum promotion blocks readiness.

open_obligations.description: Re-run endpoint analysis after representation repair.

scenarios.claim: Three contradictory endpoint runs justify a governed repair queue, not proof acceptance.
scenarios.evidence: Framework state plus five ordered advisory reviews and a meta-review.
scenarios.falsifier: Any attempted proof, release, or epistemic upgrade exceeds review authority.

scenarios.claim: A collar construction and exact endpoint calculation close a finite Route-A module only.
scenarios.evidence: Attack plan, open-point plan, specialist result packet, symbolic audit, and common manuscript validation tail.
